goal: Create a restrained photorealistic warm-tonal studio editorial portrait of one fictional mature adult man with natural age and fabric detail.
audience: Editorial art directors seeking controlled color, material realism, and a non-promotional male portrait

content.subject: One fictional 46-year-old man in an unbranded chestnut overshirt and charcoal knit against a cocoa studio field
must_include: Exactly one clearly adult fictional man
Both eyes clearly visible with calm direct gaze
Complete face, hairline, short salt-and-pepper beard, neck, and head-and-shoulders context
Natural pores, faint under-eye texture, individual beard hairs, and a small healed left-eyebrow notch
Unbranded chestnut brushed-cotton overshirt over charcoal fine-gauge knit
Plain chestnut-to-deep-cocoa seamless studio background with warm key and restrained cool edge separation
must_avoid: Extra people, duplicated features, malformed anatomy, cropped crown or chin
Sunglasses, jewelry, insignia, label, logo, text, or watermark
Beauty smoothing, plastic skin, luxury-brand campaign, glamour posing, or exaggerated cinematic effects
Real-person or celebrity likeness, collage, illustration, cartoon, anime, or CGI styling

art_direction.lighting: Broad warm camera-left key, understated cool right edge separation, low sheen, and readable deep shadow

composition.layout: Vertical head-and-shoulders portrait with quiet negative backdrop and readable shoulder fabric
focal_hierarchy: Clear adult eyes and calm expression
Natural skin, hair, and beard detail
Chestnut overshirt and charcoal knit material

objective_checks: Output is exactly 1023x1537 PNG/RGB without alpha
No visible text, logo, brand, or watermark appears
visual_checks: Face, eyes, hairline, beard, neck, shoulders, and cropped boundaries are coherent
Natural age detail, skin, beard, and fabric remain photographic without beauty smoothing
Wardrobe and studio color treatment remain restrained, unbranded, and non-promotional
The image is distinct from outdoor documentary, motion, rehearsal, craft, fashion-grid, and character-sheet imagery
